content: springdoc-openapi is the standard OpenAPI 3 + Swagger UI integration for Spring Boot 3 (springdoc-openapi-starter-webmvc-ui artifact), auto-generating docs from controllers/DTOs with zero-config defaults. Supports Spring Boot 3.x and Boot 4.x, Java 21+, OpenAPI 3.1. Version 2.x line targets Boot 3; check springdoc.org compatibility matrix for exact patch pinning.
